source.priority: Later direct approvals and central finance supersede conflicting examples; do not overwrite historical contracts.

migration.historical_legacy_L_ids: No automatic destructive remap. Retain old records; use this catalog for versioned future games.
migration.luxury_equity_legacy: Do not enable historical green-like equity as luxury under this catalog; investment registry must explicitly classify or defer.

recommended_integration_closures.rule: Alias green and luxury promotion channels to one player/lap activation allowance and one activation REP family. Preserve card-specific budgets; prevent cross-channel farming.

Personal goods, experiences, gifts, companions, and personal branding are nondeductible by default. Only explicitly linked settled operating-business activations enter the business tax bucket; additional business-scope service classification requires an authored record.

Service delivery uses an authored checkpoint and recorded completion conditions. If delayed, require an achievable checkpoint before final cutoff. No automatic rewards or refunds at Finish; unresolved permitted records close as incomplete with zero resale unless an authored cancellation applies.
Consume production discount on committed LX30 purchase. Refund does not refresh the allowance in that lap; future laps refresh normally. Actual net cost and money refund still reconcile.

For LX29, completed message plus approved delivered kit earns 1 REP; LX30 completed published series earns 2 REP; LX45 completed partnered event earns 2 REP. Partial/unfulfilled work earns 0. Existing family high-water prevents repetitions.
Price and recurring-care quotes remain visible even if unaffordable. Central credit-capacity rules override illustrative legacy financed amounts; never treat example dollars as authorization.
